name: Pesto Pasta
description: A simple and flavorful pasta dish made with pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, and Asiago cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and crumble or grate the Asiago cheese.
Beat together the pesto, balsamic vinegar, and oil from sun-dried tomatoes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, Asiago cheese, and pine nuts to the pesto mixture.
Toss the hot cooked pasta with the pesto mixture.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese on top if desired.

keywords: pesto pasta, sun-dried tomatoes, Asiago cheese, Italian cuisine

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Greek Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing Greek salad with marinated tomatoes, mixed greens, feta cheese, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: To Marinate Tomatoes: Cut tomatoes in halves or quarters. Squeeze out seeds and juice and cut into bite-size pieces. Whisk marinade together, stir in tomatoes, and let stand for at least 1 hour.

To Make Dressing: Place garlic, vinegar, and seasonings in a blender and whirl to blend. While still whirling, gradually drizzle in the oil. Add anchovies. Can be used immediately or covered and refrigerated.
To Complete Salad: Mix greens, onions, olives, pepper, and cheese. Add marinated tomatoes. Toss and drizzle dressing over salad. Add croutons if desired.

_similar.keywords: Greek salad, marinated tomatoes, feta cheese, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth
